interpretation: Input, cache write, cache read, and output categories must be priced separately.
Cache creation tokens with a known 1-hour TTL use the 1-hour price, not the 5-minute price.
Thinking tokens are already included in output_tokens; do not add them again.
Chart x coordinates use standard output-token list price only, not all-in tournament cost.
API-equivalent cost is a comparison estimate; actual billing may differ under a subscription, negotiated rates, tax, or credits.
